segments.title: Open the report
segments.subtitle: Hover highlights the row. One click opens the full report in place.

segments.title: Pick who sees it
segments.subtitle: The share panel slides in with the current access already filled in.

segments.title: Add a note
segments.subtitle: The note appears in the preview as you type, so nothing is a surprise.

segments.title: Send it
segments.subtitle: A confirmation toast shows, then the report moves to the Shared list.

segments.title: Undo if needed
segments.subtitle: Undo stays available for ten seconds and restores the previous access.
